title: The LEGO Group Reveals Collaboration with Daft Punk™
excerpt: Discover the new Daft Punk™ x LEGO® partnership and explore how two icons of creativity have joined forces for a unique collaboration
content_html:
The LEGO Group Reveals Collaboration with Daft Punk™

An Iconic Creative Partnership

Rumors confirmed! DAFT PUNK™ to enter the LEGO® universe with new partnership aiming to connect generations of Daft Punk and LEGO fans. Stay tuned for what’s next!

We can already announce that DAFT PUNK™, the iconic French electronic music duo, is making its way into the world of LEGO Ideas. Submitted to LEGO Ideas, Daft Punk Concert reached 10,000 supporters and was selected by a Review Board to move into product development.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

  • What is LEGO® Daft Punk™ Concert?

    LEGO® Daft Punk™ Concert is an exciting product idea that brings the legendary musicians to life in brick form. Submitted by a fan on the crowdsourcing platform LEGO Ideas, this creation has been selected for product development. This means the Fan Designer RobotRock will collaborate with LEGO designers to create the final LEGO Ideas set, allowing fans to construct and display a LEGO version of the iconic duo. 

  • When is LEGO® Daft Punk™ Concert coming out?

    More news to follow. Sign up for LEGO® Insiders to get the latest LEGO news: https://www.LEGO.com/page/static/subscribe

  • How big will the LEGO® Daft Punk™ Concert set be?

    Probably not as big as the real stage, but we don’t know yet. Sign up for LEGO® Insiders to get the latest LEGO news: https://www.LEGO.com/page/static/subscribe
